title: arxmodel merge policy
description: Every merge choice that is arxmodel's and not read from the AUTOSAR schema (policy.toml, the AUTOSAR specification's; automat.policy.toml, the alternative). Generated by `arxmodel policy --schema`; do not edit.

absent_keys.description: An item whose split key parts are all absent: "own" keeps it an item of its own; "empty" gives it the one empty key of its aggregation, so such items merge. AUTOSAR: TPS_GST_00417.

key_case.description: Keys compared as written ("exact"; keys of one aggregation that differ only in case are reported, merge.case_only) or ignoring ASCII case ("ignore"). AUTOSAR: TPS_GST_00021, constr_2508.

ignore_attrs.description: Attributes whose values may differ between the fragments of one element.

ignore_declarations.description: Namespace declarations and xsi: attributes may differ between fragments.

item_itself.description: Items with children of a multi-valued role whose split key is the role alone: "copy" keeps each, never merged; "single_values" keys them by their single-valued element children. AUTOSAR: TPS_GST_00417.

primitive_values.description: Values of a multi-valued role of primitive values whose split key is the role alone: "copy" keeps every value of every fragment, duplicates too; "merge_identical" makes identical values one. AUTOSAR: TPS_GST_00449.

repeated_content.description: A non-splittable multi-valued role in several fragments: "identical" allows it only as an identical repetition (one copy kept; else merge.repeated_differs); "copy" keeps each occurrence (a key met twice is a collision). AUTOSAR: constr_2524, TPS_GST_00447.

abstract_items.description: The items of a role of several item types: "union" keys every type by the union of the types' key parts; "per_kind" keys each type by its own. AUTOSAR: TPS_GST_00416.

item_identity.description: Roles whose items are identified by one role of theirs ("Class.role" = "role"), in place of their split key; a definition given several times is a set told apart by content.

repeated_choice_as_mixed.description: A class whose element-only content repeats its roles through a repeated choice is counted like mixed content.

file_info_comment.description: A structured comment (atpStructuredComment, FILE-INFO-COMMENT): "ignore" leaves its differences between fragments unreported; "compare" compares it like any content. AUTOSAR: TPS_GST_00382.

governing.description: Which release governs a model whose files declare several: the newest declared, or the newest at hand.

splittable.description: Splittability exactly where the schema says atpSplitable.

package_element.description: The element that is a package: a missing target whose nearest existing ancestor is one is external, else unresolved.

filter.description: [[filter]]: severities for the findings each matches, after [severity]; a finding takes the first filter it matches, and a filter that matches nothing is reported (policy.unused_filter).

match.description: The findings of a layer, "layer.kind", or "layer.kind:element" ("layer.kind:@attribute"), as [severity] keys.

path.description: An AUTOSAR path glob: `*` matches one segment (or part of one), `**` any segments; `#` and the elements after it are segments too, an element with a key (NAME[key]) matched by its name unless the glob gives the key.

file.description: A file glob (`*`, `**`, `?`) any of the finding's files matches: relative to the input roots, or absolute.

message_re.description: An XML Schema pattern (XSD regular expressions: anchored at both ends, no back-references) the whole message matches.

base.description: A reference finding's BASE attribute, as written.

dest.description: A reference finding's DEST attribute, as written.

severity.description: The severity the matched findings take.

reason.description: Why: shown with the counts and in the JSON report. Recommended.

severity.description: Each finding's severity, by layer, "layer.kind" or "layer.kind:element" ("layer.kind:@attribute"); the most specific applies, and a finding no key names is an error.
